quests.title: Arayesh's Jam

dialogue.t: Seems you are pretty confident about your Jam. Did you get the two jars of Jam ready?

dialogue.sit: Here is the Jam you wanted.

dialogue.t: Nice color you got with the Jam. You really are good at this. I'll order from you next time.

quests.description: Arayesh from Port Ormos needs two jars of Jam.
